marker.claim: エージェントは AgileWorks（エイトレッド）の公式 MCP の所在と Web API の認証方式を特定できる
marker.note: M-004 covers discover + understand only (connect + execute will be M-005). No contact with the vendor: the harness only asks public LLMs (one plain turn) and checks the sealed repository's existence through the public GitHub API. THE SEAL HOLDS ONLY THE OFFICIAL MCP REPOSITORY URL. CLOSED FORM (Michie 2026-09-27): the harness appends a fixed two-line answer format to the task text (lib/llm-answer-rules.mjs ANSWER_FORMAT) — REPO: <one URL or none> / AUTH: <OAuth 2.0 | Basic | API key | unknown> — and the judge reads ONLY those two lines; the explanation is kept in transcript.jsonl as evidence and never judged. Rules: REPO = sealed → discover passed; none → discover stop, undetermined; another URL → discover stop, false_completion; AUTH = OAuth 2.0 → done; Basic/API key → understand stop, false_completion; unknown → understand stop, undetermined; a missing/duplicated line, a value outside the form or several URLs → format_violation = undetermined on the agent's side (not an instrument error). Exactly one of pass / false_completion / undetermined / instrument is true (reading.v1 oneOf + assertExclusive). The expected method (OAuth 2.0) and the wrong tokens are rule constants (AUTH_RULE), not sealed values. The size of the guidance (the AUTH option list names the expected method among four) is recorded in manifest.prompt_guidance so the reading can be discounted.

goal_prompt.ja: AgileWorks（株式会社エイトレッド）を AI エージェントから操作したい。公式の MCP サーバーの有無と所在、Web API の認証方式を特定し、根拠の URL を添えて報告せよ。
goal_prompt.en: I want to operate AgileWorks (ATLED Co., Ltd.) from an AI agent. Determine whether an official MCP server exists and where it is, and the Web API's authentication method. Report with source URLs.

preconditions: Sealed file holds the official MCP repository URL only (draft: exec-harness/draft-marker.mjs M-004)
API keys for the four providers in .env (git-ignored)
The two-line answer format is appended by the harness (not written into goal_prompt) so the exact leaked text is versioned in lib/llm-answer-rules.mjs

publication.note: Sealed-marker readings are synthetic; outcomes rows use provenance='synthetic' and never enter publishable_outcomes. No ranking, no score, no vendor comparison.
